Chapter rule 2: A nonoriginating material or component will not be deemed to have satisfied all other applicable requirements of these rules by reason of a change from one classification to another merely as the result of the separation of one or more individual materials or components from a man-made mixture unless the isolated material or component, itself, also underwent a chemical reaction.
